name: @nanocodana/nodejs
//dependencies: just-bash is a real dependency here, not vendored as in core. On Node its assets resolve inside node_modules exactly as designed, and node:zlib is available — the vendoring in core exists to survive runtimes where neither is true. Core is imported through its /no-bash entry so its own 1.2 MB shell never enters a consumer's bundle alongside this one.
//optionalDependencies: Only ripgrep is ours — the Grep tool prefers the native binary and falls back to the JS implementation when it is absent. just-bash declares its own native codecs (@mongodb-js/zstd, node-liblzma) as optional, so `npm install --omit=optional` prunes all three at once and costs only `tar -J`/`--zstd` and native-speed grep.
description: Run a NanoCodana coding agent over your real filesystem, with a sandboxed shell that can escalate to the host on approval.
